tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Find, list or compare maid / domestic-worker recruitment agencies (housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers, caregivers) in a city or country - e.g. 'maid agencies in Dubai' -> city: Dubai. Use this for any 'agencies in <place>' question. Searches agencies listed on GCC Domestic across the six GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). Filter by country, city and/or a free-text name query. Returns contact details, whether each agency is government-verified (1,300+ are), and the official registry link where one exists.

country.description: Country: uae | ksa | kuwait | qatar | bahrain | oman

city.description: City name, e.g. Dubai, Riyadh, Doha

query.description: Free-text search over agency names (English or Arabic)

tools.name: verify_agency_licence
tools.description: Check the licence of ONE specific agency the user names (or its licence / facility number). Not for finding or listing agencies in a city or country - use search_agencies for that. Look up by agency name, or by licence / facility number (e.g. a UAE MOHRE facility number or Saudi Musaned reference). Returns the licence status recorded on GCC Domestic plus the official government registry link for independent verification.

country.description: Optional country filter: uae | ksa | kuwait | qatar | bahrain | oman

tools.name: search_workers
tools.description: Browse domestic workers currently listed as available through GCC agencies listed on GCC Domestic - housemaids, nannies, cooks, drivers and caregivers. Filter by nationality and/or position. Returns public profile info and the agency to contact; hiring goes through the worker's agency.

nationality.description: Worker nationality or home country, e.g. Filipino or Philippines, Ethiopian or Ethiopia, Indian

position.description: Role, e.g. Housemaid, Nanny, Driver, Cook, Caregiver

tools.name: get_salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Published monthly salary benchmarks for domestic workers in the Gulf, by country and worker nationality. These are the same bands published across gccdomestic.com (salary calculator, 2026 salary report). Currencies: UAE in AED, Saudi Arabia in SAR.

country.description: uae or ksa (bands published for these; other GCC countries return guide links)

nationality.description: Nationality or home country, e.g. filipino or Philippines, ethiopian, indian, indonesian, sri-lankan, kenyan, ugandan, nepali, bangladeshi, ghanaian

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over GCC Domestic's published guides, blog posts and country pages (English + Arabic): visas, Tadbeer/Musaned/PAM/ADLSA/LMRA/MOL procedures, salaries, contracts, refunds, worker rights. Returns title, URL and a snippet. Read-only; each result carries its URL.

query.description: Question or keywords, English or Arabic

lang.description: Language of the guides to search: en or ar

tools.name: get_platform_guide
tools.description: How hiring a domestic worker through GCC Domestic works, with canonical links: country directories, the application page for workers, pricing, and verification guides. Use this to orient before deeper searches, or to hand a user the right link.

country.description: Optional country focus: uae | ksa | kuwait | qatar | bahrain | oman
